notes.title: April '24 Audio Patch
notes.content: Just a small update to tune the environmental sound on the island. Less buzzing insects. Some more birds. And player footsteps are softer.

notes.title: March 2024 Update
notes.content:
I think this might be the last update as I move on to new projects. 

Patch notes: 

Table of Contents now displays how many creatures you have photographed at each portal visited. 
As well as the total amount of creatures inside the portal to help you track down missing creatures. 

Localization for 10 languages. German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Arabic, Norwegian, and Scottish Gaelic. 
I used a web service so these translations are probably full of errors, so it is not officially noted on the store page. I just wanted to have something in case someone really wants to play and the language is a barrier to them. 

The mountaintop will now unlock at 15 portals found rather than 17.

Dragon will not repeat dialog if you have acquired the Underworld portal token

Crown token is automatically registered after getting to the top of the mountain

The Photo Gallery remembers the last gallery type you viewed and should load faster. It is reset to current roll after going through a portal. 

Fixed some Remapping bugs. And the tutorial now displays the right key if changed before starting the game. (Desktop)

[R] is now the default key to open the book on desktop (Desktop)

You can open the menu if the book is spawned. It will close the book then open the menu.  (Desktop)

Default walking speed is slower (Desktop)

Tweaked sound mix and game should be a little less loud.

The VR camera now has an image to indicate the flash button. 

Other smaller bug fixes and enhancements.

notes.title: PANdemonium Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] 4 New Portals to explore plus a slideshow gallery portal to watch your favorite photos. 

[*] New creatures upping the total in the game to 127. 
[/list]
You can find the new portals [spoiler]near the gnome village, in the middle of the Lake, at the ruins near the mountain stairs, and from the crown dropped by the Man on the Mountain.[/spoiler] Visit [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2910265205]the guide[/url] if you need help tracking down the new creatures. 

This will be the last major update to the game as I look ahead to new projects. I'm honored to have so many people play and enjoy this weird little game I made. Thank you for your support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37165131/aca8c4204fa9cb2105f86dbc5f63e39d79d24ec4.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.015
notes.content:
- Fixed export photo bugs for both VR and Flatscreen. Will no longer be locked out if selecting export folder location while in windowed mode

Apologies for the small patch size but it was game breaking for some users. Updates will hopefully only happen during content updates from now on (new characters or levels). The slow patching speed has been noted, and I'm sorry for any inconvenience.

notes.title: Update 1.014
notes.content:
Sorry about the double patches this week, but I wanted to implement some changes that were bothering flatscreen players. 

-Windowed Mode now works. VR players can switch to windowed mode by switching to flatscreen then selecting windowed mode and switching back to VR. 

-Stopping after running is now quicker for flatscreen players. Not as much sliding. 

-Hold down shift to Sprint for flatscreen keyboard and mouse players (Controller is still press once)

-Subtitles is now enabled as the default for new games on Flatscreen. 

-Escape now opens menu as well as closing it for Flatscreen. And is a shortcut to quit for VR players. Tab key still works for the menu and can be remapped.

notes.title: Update 1.013
notes.content:
Added HP Reverb 2 Support. (thanks Joeyhodge!)

Fixed problem with Sheep Dream Token not registering achievement progress

Fixed problem with Fractal Room Token not registering achievement progress

Fixed Funguy subtitles to accurately reflect the spoken dialog. 

Fixed WiseTree subtitles to accurately reflect the spoken dialog. 

Fixed Cloud god subtitles to accurately reflect the spoken dialog. 

Fixed Faerie King subtitles to accurately reflect the spoken dialog. 

Now that the craziness of launch week is over, and I'm back to my day job, updates will slow down for a bit. I've really appreciated the positive response to the game so far. It means everything to me that it has resonated with so many people.  I have every intention to create more content for Isle of Pan; some more creatures, maybe a portal or two. So keep an eye out for that this Spring. I just need some rest first.  

Keep sharing those photos with #IsleofPan.

notes.title: Update 1.012
notes.content:
-Improved force grab for VR players:
The default is now A button to bring up the laser beam. And Trigger to select. This is more inline with other VR games. 
If you liked the previous way, you can toggle the option under the settings menu with height adjustment. Its at the bottom of the page. And you can change it by left or right hand

-VR sprinting is now click rather than holding down the thumbstick

-Fixed teleporting while using force grab with Vive wands

-Added the rest of the musicians to the credits

-Mountain spiral was made smaller to avoid clipping

-Lochie not appearing is hopefully fixed, please let me know if you still have problems.

From now on, updates will only be once a week at most. Thank you for your patience with the updates this week and keep posting those photos!

notes.title: Updated Release Date: January
notes.content:
Hey Everyone. I was on track to release in December, but the flu hit me really hard this month. Being a solo dev, I need to push the release to January for the better of the game and my health. My apologies. 

Stay hydrated friends.

notes.title: Isle of Pan is Releasing December 13th
notes.content:
Isle of Pan will be releasing December 13th! (noon Eastern)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37165131/5ea36232ba6f9b73842ffbf67002cabe076b7e28.png[/img]

----------------------------------------------------------------------

I took a lot of your feedback and made changes and patched the game as well as the demo. 
Here are some changes. 

VR
-You can now set the camera rotation while being held. Find this option in the menu
-You can change the rotation rate of smooth rotation. 
-Changes to kinesis to make it easier.
-Snap to hand grabbing option using the A button while hand is over object. 
-Menu options now displayed in first level to allow easy access and help the player understand what is available before starting.
-major bug fixed 
-locomotion bug fixes

Desktop
-Underwater visibility at night fixed. 
-remapping and settings issues fixed
-Escape now works for menus
-Tab tutorial for opening menu
-Tutorial bug fixes

I also decided the demo will be available through launch if not forever. I know my game is weird and I want people to be as informed as possible before buying.  

Can't wait to have you play it!

[b]Remember to export and share your photos with the real world using #IsleofPan[/b]

[url=https://discord.gg/YtFtPxF]Join our Discord. [/url]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest: Updated Demo
notes.content:
We've released an updated demo for the Steam Next Fest! The plan is to have it available all the way until release. 

Updates include: 
Performance enhancements.
Major changes to the desktop version.
Seagulls and Ravens.
Changeable photo limit. Default is now 500. 
New telekinesis system.  
Numerous bug fixes.

Feel free to provide feedback in the community section
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1050260/discussions/0/3430074255270212174/

Or on our Discord
https://discord.gg/YtFtPxF

We have two livestreams coming up during the Fest week. Come chat with me as you watch me awkwardly play my game. 

Tuesday, October 4th, 4:00PM EDT (1:00PM PDT)
Saturday, October 8th, 10:00PM EDT (7:00PM PDT)  (Video will be replayed but the chat will be live)

We're also looking for someone to let us know how it's working with WMR HMD! 

And just a quick tip; I've noticed that with SteamVR the game runs a lot better with motion smoothing turned OFF. Let us know if you have a similar experience. 

Have a great week!
